statement: CVE-2026-75650, the Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source remote code execution flaw Adobe confirmed as actively exploited on 2026-09-08, is added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-29.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog lists CVE-2026-75650 with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-29 inclusive.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-75650 is absent from the CISA KEV catalog as of 2026-10-01, or its dateAdded value falls after 2026-09-29.
